item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Vihaan lighting an incense stick. It burns with a steady tip of glowing ash and smoke. He then covers the incense stick with a glass tumbler. After some time the glowing tip goes out.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: While it burns, the incense stick needs fuel, oxygen from the air, and heat above its ignition temperature.
options.B: Under the tumbler the glowing tip goes out when the oxygen inside runs low.
options.C: The incense stick catches fire as soon as it softens in air.
options.D: An incense stick left in air at room temperature will start burning without being heated.
